## Problem

What problem does this feature solve. Who hits it and how often.

## Proposal

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they fall short.

## Scope

- Which airframe(s) does this affect.
- Which board profile(s).
- Does it affect the control loop, mixer, failsafe, actuator output, IMU, or RX. (If yes, this is safety-critical. See [SAFETY.md](../../SAFETY.md).)
- Is this in or out of scope for the current v1 release plan. (See the roadmap.)

## Anything else

Sketches, references to papers or datasheets, related issues.
